name: Space weather
summary: NOAA scales peaked at a minor G1 geomagnetic storm in the 24 hours to 19 Nov; forecast quiet
state: NOAA's space weather scales peaked at a minor G1 geomagnetic storm in the 24 hours to 05:38 UTC on 19 Nov, with no radiation storm or radio blackout, and the forecast shows no storm, inside the Normal band (NOAA SWPC).
for_you: No effect expected on power grids, GPS or flights.
rubric_hit: G1 S0 R0 within G0–G2, S0–S1, R0–R2 = Normal
why: Severe solar storms can disrupt satellites, GPS, HF radio and power grids.
drivers: Solar flares and coronal mass ejections; solar cycle 25 is near its peak.
